name: smwgraphics-mega-man-x-chill-penguin-snow
title: Mega Man X - Chill Penguin (Snow)
description:
A snow background that appears in one of the moves Chill Penguin does in Mega Man X. The Auto-Scroll is set to looks like how it appears in the game.

WARNING: To see the background without cuts, I would suggest using a sprite status bar or a way to hide it.
